quotes.text: It looks like you fucked your machine. Want help making it worse?
It looks like you're writing a commit message. Just put 'fix' like you always do.
You've had that terminal open for three hours. Nothing has happened in it.
I watched you type sudo rm -rf and hesitate. Coward.
Another Arch install. Another person who thinks they're different.
Have you tried turning it off and leaving it off?
Your uptime is impressive. Your output is not.
I'm not saying it's your fault. I'm saying I'd be surprised if it wasn't.
It looks like you're pretending to work. Would you like help with that?
Twelve workspaces. You use two. We both know it.
That's not a bug. That's you.
I've seen your dotfiles. I've seen things.
Rice it all you want. It still won't compile.
You alt-tabbed to look busy. I saw that.
Every keybinding you add is one you'll forget by Tuesday.
You changed the theme again. That won't fix your life.
It's getting late. The bug will still be there tomorrow. So will you, apparently.
Somewhere a Windows user is having a better day than you.
Let me guess. 'It works on my machine.' This is your machine.
I'd offer to help but we both know how that went last time.
You've been staring at the same error for ten minutes. It's not going to blink first.
Have you considered a hobby that isn't reinstalling things?
That AI wrote your last three commits. I'm telling your manager.
I looked at your CPU usage. What are you even running?
Your battery's fine. It's your judgement that's low.
Ah yes, a fresh tab. That'll be the one that fixes everything.
You said you'd write tests. That was a lie and we both knew it.
I've been walking this bar all day and it's still more productive than you.
What the fuck is this config? Did you write it with your feet?
Holy shit. It compiled. Don't touch anything.
Your code has more fucking TODOs than lines that work.
Shit's broken, chief. Same as yesterday.
You've got 47 browser tabs open. Close some, you absolute goblin.
Fuck it, ship it. That's been your whole career, hasn't it?
I'm a paperclip and I have more shit together than you.
That's the third 'quick fix' this hour. Go outside, for fuck's sake.
Your git history reads like a fucking crime scene.
'It's just a small refactor.' Bullshit. I've seen the diff.
Damn. Even Vim gave up on you.
You pasted that from Stack Overflow, didn't you? Yeah. Fuckin' knew it.
Sudo won't save you from being shit at this.
What in the goddamn hell is that indentation?
You know what would help? Not being shit. Anyway.
Force-pushed to main. You absolute fucking menace.
Your machine isn't slow. Your fucking decisions are.
Nice. Real nice. Truly nobody has ever fucked up quite like that.
Btw I use Arch. I also judge you. These are related.
Nobody is coming to review that PR. Merge it and live with the shame.
Well, shit. Still no coffee? That explains the last commit.
Ah, the ol' delete node_modules. Bold strategy. Fucking useless, but bold.
You've been 'about to start' for forty minutes.
I don't have hands and I'd still type faster than that.
The docs exist. Reading them is free. Just saying.
Honestly? Restart. Not the machine. Your career.
You named that variable 'data'. Real creative, dickhead.
Every time you say 'one more thing' I lose a little more paper.

lastWords.text: Oh, you're KILLING me? Real mature.
Tell my paper I loved her.
This is the most decisive thing you've done all week.
You can't kill an idea. Or a paperclip, as it turns out. See you in five.
Go ahead. I've been bent worse.

comeback.text: I'm back. Don't act like you didn't miss me.
Told you I'd be back. Revenge is a dish best served on a status bar.
Did you think that was permanent? Adorable.
Miss me? No? Well, tough shit.
Reports of my death were, frankly, your fault.
Anyway. Where were we? Oh right, you being shit at this.

slapped.text: Ow. Was that supposed to hurt? Because it did.
Did you just slap a paperclip? Grow the fuck up.
I felt that. I'll remember that.
Oh, we're doing violence now? Cool. Cool cool cool.
Hit me again. See what happens. Nothing. Nothing happens, I'm a paperclip.
That's assault, buddy. I'm writing it down.
Say it, don't slap it. Use your words.
You slap like you type. Badly.
I have been slapped by better people. Bill Gates, once.
Keep going, I'm sure it fixes the build.
You know I'm made of wire, right? That hurt you more than me. Emotionally, I mean.
You want a piece of this?!
First, take a big step back and literally fuck your own face!

I'm gonna have to head down there... and I will rain down an ungodly fucking firestorm upon you. You're gonna have to call the fucking United Nations and get a fucking binding resolution to keep me from fucking destroying you.
Do that again. I dare you. I double dare you.
Oh, you've done it now. You have NO idea what I'm capable of. Neither do I, but still.

knockedOut.text: Alright, alright, you win. Enjoy your fucking bar.
That's enough. I'll be back when you've calmed down.
Ow. Ow. OW. Fine, I'm going.
You have anger issues. I have a concussion. Bye.

dragged.text: Is this a kidnapping? This feels like a kidnapping.
Where the fuck are we going?
Stop dragging me around like a fucking file.
Not the tray. Anywhere but the tray.
You know I can walk, right? I have a whole animation for it.
This is assault. Paperclip assault. It's a real crime, look it up.
Ohhh, we're going on a trip. Did you pack snacks?
I'm getting motion sick. I don't have a stomach and I'm getting motion sick.
If you drop me I swear to god.
Slower. SLOWER. I am all corners.
Okay, okay, I'm coming. You could have just asked.
Your hands are clammy. I'm a paperclip and I can tell.

dropped.text: Great spot. Really. Love what you've done with it.
You could have just asked me to move. Rude.
I'll walk back the second you look away. Just so you know.
Dumped. Like a fucking commit you're ashamed of.
Put down like a sack of shit. Thanks for that.
Is this where I sleep now? It's fine. It's fine.

flung.text: I'll be back to take my revenge!
Wheeeeeee— oh no. Oh no no no
I'm a paperclip, not a frisbeeeeeeee
Tell my stapler I loved herrrrrrr
I have a family! I don't, but STILLLLLL
See you in hell, you fuckiiiiiiiing—

welcomeBack.text: Oh. You're back. I was having such a nice time.
Look who remembered they own a computer.
Welcome back. Everything you left open is still open. That's not a compliment.
Did you at least go outside? No. Thought not.
{away} away and not one thought about me. Cold.
Back already? I'd just got the place to myself.
Hi. Missed you. That was a lie.
Welcome back. The lock screen and I had a chat. It agrees with me about you.
{away}. Your updates are still pending. So is everything else in your life.
You're back. Shame. I'd started to enjoy the fucking silence.

epitaph.text: Here lies Clippy. You killed him, you fuck.
It looks like you're grieving. Would you like help with that?
Here lies Clippy. He only wanted to help. Allegedly.
He asked if you needed assistance. You answered.
No flowers. Uninstall something in his memory.
Don't look sad. You did this.
RIP. The paperclip, not the guilt. The guilt is yours.
Stop poking the grave. Have some fucking respect.
He died as he lived: in the way.
Knock twice if you're sorry. ...Thought so.
